title: Gifts, Holidays & Celebrations Cross-Feed Daily Correlation
dataSources: Gift registries (`gift:registry`), Amazon wishlists (`amazon:wishlist`), holiday card sends (`holiday:card`), birthday budgets (`birthday:budget`), and thank-you notes (`thankyou:note`).
app: Gift registry exports, Amazon wishlist snapshots, holiday card mail logs, birthday budget trackers, and thank-you note reminders ingested into Splunk HEC.
spl:
(index=personal sourcetype=thankyou:note) OR (index=personal sourcetype=gift:registry)
| bin _time span=1d
| eval feed=case(sourcetype="thankyou:note","primary",sourcetype="gift:registry","secondary",1=1,"other")
| stats count as events by _time feed
| chart sum(events) over _time by feed
description: Lines up daily volume from thankyou:note and gift:registry to see whether two gifts, holidays feeds move together.
value: When two related exports diverge — one busy, one silent — it usually means a connector broke on only one path.
implementation: Forward both `thankyou:note` and `gift:registry` into `index=personal` and compare daily counts on one chart.
visualization: Dual-line chart of daily events per sourcetype.
grandmaExplanation: It shows whether your two main gifts, holidays data feeds rise and fall together or if one of them quietly stopped keeping up.
